Certificate Course

Music Production

3 Months. One complete journey from idea to finished music.

Learn music production through hands-on studio sessions, working through the same process used to build a track from scratch.

Month 01 - Build the Foundation

  • DAW & studio workflow
  • MIDI & virtual instruments
  • Melody and sound selection
  • Beat, rhythm & groove
  • Session setup and signal flow

Month 02 - Create Your Sound

  • Arrangement & song structure
  • Composition, mood & emotion
  • Indian instruments in modern production
  • AI-assisted music creation
  • Film scoring fundamentals
  • Background score techniques

Month 03 - Finish Like a Professional

  • Mixing & critical listening
  • EQ, compression, reverb & delay
  • Sound design & creative processing
  • Textures, atmospheres, risers & impacts
  • Professional session workflow
  • Final project & delivery
By the end of the course, you’ll have more than just software knowledge. You’ll have actually created and finished your own music.

Certificate Course

Sound Engineering

3 Months. From setting up a session to delivering a finished mix.

Learn how sound actually works in a professional studio, from microphones and recording to editing, mixing and final delivery. Every stage is taught through hands-on studio work.

Month 01 - Understand the Signal

  • Studio & DAW workflow
  • Signal flow and gain staging
  • Microphones & microphone techniques
  • Audio interfaces, preamps & monitoring
  • Recording vocals & instruments
  • Session setup and organisation

Month 02 - Shape the Sound

  • Editing & session preparation
  • EQ & frequency balance
  • Compression & dynamics
  • Reverb, delay & spatial depth
  • Vocal processing
  • Creative effects & sound shaping

Month 03 - Mix & Deliver

  • Mixing workflow
  • Balance, panning & stereo image
  • Advanced processing & automation
  • Critical listening & mix decisions
  • Mix preparation & professional delivery
  • Final mixing project
By the end of the course, you'll be able to record, edit and mix a session from start to finish like a working sound engineer.

Keyboard & Piano Program

Keyboard & Piano

Learn to play. Understand the music. Build your foundation.

A structured keyboard program combining Trinity-based practical training with music theory, helping students develop technique, musical understanding, sight-reading and confidence at the keyboard.

Foundation

  • Keyboard & piano fundamentals
  • Scales, chords & chord progressions
  • Music notation & sight-reading

Technique & Musicality

  • Rhythm, timing & finger technique
  • Ear training
  • Practical pieces & performance

Theory & Performance

  • Music theory fundamentals
  • Trinity exam preparation
  • Expression, accompaniment & improvisation
From your first notes to playing with confidence. Learn the instrument and understand the music behind it.
